result:
Em dash matches exactly (U+2014). The build passes and the implementation is complete.

Summary of what I implemented for Section 4 (Health/HealthKit) only:

- **`app/components/Health.vue`** — wired to `HKHealthStore` for step count read/write:
  - Status line reflects sharing (write) authorization status, refreshed on `navigatedTo` and after each request.
  - `Request Access` requests read+write authorization; `Log 500 Steps` is enabled only when granted and saves a quantity sample (start=end=now).
  - Last 7 Days list uses `HKStatisticsCollectionQuery` (daily cumulative sum) to build exactly 7 rows, most-recent-first, formatted `Wkd Mon D — N,NNN steps`, today emphasized and suffixed ` (today)`; shows `Health access needed` when not granted.
  - Errors from save/request/query surface as text in the status line.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription` / `NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements`** (new) — `com.apple.developer.healthkit` entitlement.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — added a reference to the HealthKit typings (present in `@nativescript/types-ios` but not included by the default type bundle).

`ns build ios` succeeds, and I confirmed the entitlement and Info.plist keys correctly propagate into the generated Xcode project. Home.vue and Transcribe.vue were left untouched.
